question: The height of a pyramid is 8 m, and the base of the pyramid is a square whose diagonal is sqrt{512} m. Find the approximate volume of the pyramid.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Area of the square base = (Diagonal)² ÷ 2 = (√512)² ÷ 2 = 512 ÷ 2 = 256 m².

Volume of the pyramid = (1/3) × Base Area × Height

Volume = (1/3) × 256 × 8 = 2048 ÷ 3 ≈ 682.67 m³.

Rounding to the nearest integer gives 683 m³.

**∴ The correct answer is 683 m³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Height of the pyramid (h) = 8 m

Diagonal of the square base (d) = √512 m

**Formula Used:**

Area of square = d² ÷ 2

Volume of pyramid = (1/3) × Area of base × Height

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6eb4e0563debfe196576c403bc5bf32278eebd4f8507f24666abf8c953bae1d.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area of base = (√512)² ÷ 2

⇒ Area of base = 512 ÷ 2 = 256 m²

⇒ Volume of pyramid = (1/3) × Area of base × Height

⇒ Volume of pyramid = (1/3) × 256 × 8

⇒ Volume of pyramid = 2048 ÷ 3

⇒ Volume of pyramid ≈ 682.66 m³

⇒ The approximate volume is 683 m³.

**∴ The correct answer is 683 m³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Pyramid

The general formula V = (1/3) × Base Area × Height holds true for any pyramid, regardless of whether its base is triangular, square, or polygonal.

Area of a Square

Usually found using Side², but when only the diagonal is known, directly applying Area = (Diagonal)² ÷ 2 is much faster.

Lateral Surface Area (LSA)

For a regular pyramid, LSA = (1/2) × Perimeter of the Base × Slant Height.

Total Surface Area (TSA)

The Total Surface Area is the sum of the Lateral Surface Area and the Area of the Base.
